atoms.b: The ancient Greek word photo means 'light'. Cameras and copy machines use light to capture things. That is why pictures are also called ((++photo))graphs and a copy is also called a ((++photo))copy.

atoms.title: Riddle
atoms.b: Most plants produce oxygen and their own food with the help of sunlight, water and the earth they grow in. This process has a certain name. Can you figure out the riddle?

end.text: That’s it! Photosynthesis describes the synthesis, or making, of oxygen and food by plants through the use of light.
